content: Our people have made their choice. The best course of action, for now at least, is for Babel to back down.

raw: [name="Theresa"]I will continue to call the nourishing rain upon Kazdel, change the city's circumstances, and wait for hatred to subside.
speaker: Theresa
content: I will continue to call the nourishing rain upon Kazdel, change the city's circumstances, and wait for hatred to subside.

speaker: Theresa
content: But...

raw: [name="Theresa"]If you become the greatest threat to the searching dreamers in this long and painstaking process, I will destroy you.
speaker: Theresa
content: If you become the greatest threat to the searching dreamers in this long and painstaking process, I will destroy you.

speaker: Theresis
content: So be it.

raw: Mercenaries and Royal Court soldiers line the streets, holding back the restless crowd.
content: Mercenaries and Royal Court soldiers line the streets, holding back the restless crowd.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="It was the King of Sarkaz who brought food and shelter.", x=320,y=300, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=640,block = true)]
text: It was the King of Sarkaz who brought food and shelter.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIt was also the King of Sarkaz who allowed oppression and hatred to fester.",block = true)]
text: \nIt was also the King of Sarkaz who allowed oppression and hatred to fester.

raw: The Babel procession stretches as far as the eye can see, past the barricades formed by lines of Royal Court soldiers, past the disdainful crowd.
content: The Babel procession stretches as far as the eye can see, past the barricades formed by lines of Royal Court soldiers, past the disdainful crowd.

raw: Theresis walks toward the crowd and stands with them.
content: Theresis walks toward the crowd and stands with them.

raw: He has left Theresa's side for the first time in two centuries.
content: He has left Theresa's side for the first time in two centuries.

raw: [name="Theresa"]We all know what we must face.
speaker: Theresa
content: We all know what we must face.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I hope this will not be the last time we stand together.
speaker: Theresis
content: I hope this will not be the last time we stand together.

speaker: Theresa
content: ...Will that day be far?

speaker: Theresis
content: Not too far.

raw: Theresa joins the silent procession. Their farewell to the city is soundless. Their path is one of hope.
content: Theresa joins the silent procession. Their farewell to the city is soundless. Their path is one of hope.

raw: Then, something occurs, enough to silence the restless onlookers and momentarily halt the procession.
content: Then, something occurs, enough to silence the restless onlookers and momentarily halt the procession.

raw: The cursing and crying cease. Every eye turns to a single, poignant scene.
content: The cursing and crying cease. Every eye turns to a single, poignant scene.

raw: A mercenary steps out of the line to embrace his best friend in the procession.
content: A mercenary steps out of the line to embrace his best friend in the procession.

raw: No one can hear the whispers exchanged between the two friends by the ruins of Babel, but all are willing to wait and give them their moment of farewell.
content: No one can hear the whispers exchanged between the two friends by the ruins of Babel, but all are willing to wait and give them their moment of farewell.

raw: A farewell between the people and their city, and between two peoples of the same blood.
content: A farewell between the people and their city, and between two peoples of the same blood.

raw: A young Sarkaz, who has lost everyone he holds dear, walks in the procession without regret.
content: A young Sarkaz, who has lost everyone he holds dear, walks in the procession without regret.

raw: He remembers walking the same path, leaving the city in search of his parents with his older companion many years ago.
content: He remembers walking the same path, leaving the city in search of his parents with his older companion many years ago.

raw: [name="Odda"]Dad, I believe that there has to be another way than war.
speaker: Odda
content: Dad, I believe that there has to be another way than war.

raw: [name="Odda"]Mom, I know you believed in Babel because you hoped for a different way to live.
speaker: Odda
content: Mom, I know you believed in Babel because you hoped for a different way to live.

speaker: Odda
content: Goodbye, Mom, Dad.

speaker: Odda
content: Goodbye, home.
For Theresa's eyes only,

raw: I have heard of what happened in Kazdel and share your sense of loss. The city holds special meaning to us all.
content: I have heard of what happened in Kazdel and share your sense of loss. The city holds special meaning to us all.

raw: But Babel need not drift on the wastelands, for I have located the ship I previously mentioned in Rim Billiton.
content: But Babel need not drift on the wastelands, for I have located the ship I previously mentioned in Rim Billiton.

raw: The excavation went smoothly, and the ship's basic functions have been restored after two years of work.
content: The excavation went smoothly, and the ship's basic functions have been restored after two years of work.

raw: It will carry the hopes of Babel into the future. Please wait for me, Theresa.
content: It will carry the hopes of Babel into the future. Please wait for me, Theresa.

raw: P.S.: I did find it on the ship.
content: P.S.: I did find it on the ship.

raw: A legacy that could bring upheaval to this land.
content: A legacy that could bring upheaval to this land.

raw: Given its importance, I feel it is crucial to discuss this matter with you in person.
content: Given its importance, I feel it is crucial to discuss this matter with you in person.
With hope, Kal'tsit
